mapper.select: SELECT t.class_key, c.class_name, t.unit_key, u.unit_name, COUNT(ta.student_id) AS base_count FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON t.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} GROUP BY t.class_key, c.class_name, t.unit_key, u.unit_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_order (class_key, unit_key, center_code, user_code, base_count, add_count, total_count, yy, mm, created_at) VALUES (#{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{centerCode}, #{userCode}, #{baseCount}, #{addCount}, #{totalCount}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT cf.class_key AS classKey, cf.fee AS fee, cc.class_name AS className, cc.class_type AS classType FROM erp_class_fee_map cf JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cf.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE cf.center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO erp_class_fee_map (class_key, center_code, fee) VALUES
(#{item.classKey}, #{item.centerCode}, #{item.fee})
